name: Madikeri Fort
blurb: Tourists explore this historic fort featuring a palace, a museum, and two life-sized elephant statues.

name: Talakaveri
blurb: Pilgrims visit the sacred origin point of the holy River Kaveri atop the Brahmagiri hills.

name: Abbey Falls
blurb: Visitors come to witness spectacular water cascading amidst lush coffee plantations and spice estates.

name: Tadiandamol Peak
blurb: Trekking enthusiasts climb Coorg's highest peak for panoramic vistas of the Western Ghats.

name: Dubare Elephant Camp
blurb: People visit to interact with elephants, bathe them in the river, and enjoy jungle safaris.

name: Namdroling Monastery
blurb: Worshippers and tourists admire the stunning golden Buddha statues and vibrant Tibetan architecture.

name: Bylakuppe
blurb: Visitors experience authentic Tibetan culture, monasteries, and bustling handicraft markets.

name: Iruppu Falls
blurb: Nature lovers trek through the Brahmagiri range to reach this picturesque cascade steeped in mythological significance.

name: Nagarhole National Park
blurb: Wildlife lovers go on safaris here to spot tigers, leopards, elephants, and diverse bird species.

name: Brindavan Gardens
blurb: Tourists stroll through terraced botanical gardens and enjoy the famous musical fountain show.

name: Chamundeshwari Temple
blurb: Devotees trek up Chamundi Hill to seek blessings at this revered temple overlooking Mysore city.

name: Mysore Palace
blurb: Visitors marvel at the opulent Indo-Saracenic architecture and dazzling evening illuminations just a two-hour drive away.
